text.時を経ても色あせることのないデザインの北欧家具やヴィンテージ家具、カラフルなアー: An apartment renovation with a character of its own, suited to Scandinavian and vintage furniture whose design does not fade with time, and to colourful art. So that the kitchen and living room — where one can sit unhurried and look at the greenery through the window — would hold their own against such furniture, the walls are lime plaster and the floor is walnut laid in herringbone. The built-in joinery in the kitchen and dining room is finished in a pale Farrow & Ball water-based paint, for the sake of its texture, and the result is a texture found nowhere else. The children's room has parquet flooring of the kind that recalls an old schoolroom, and Farrow & Ball hand-painted paper on the walls, which makes it a charming space.
text.リビングダイニングの床は、ヘリンボーン貼りにした15ミリの厚さのある床暖房用の無: The living and dining floor is solid walnut 15 mm thick, suitable for use over underfloor heating, laid in herringbone. Finished in natural oil; with time the oils in the timber itself deepen the colour and the sheen. Rather than fixing straight to the concrete slab, we build a timber floor beneath it, which gives the floor a little spring and makes it good to walk on.
text.オーダーでつくった淡いグレーのセミオープンのキッチン。一般的な工場塗装ではなく、: A semi-open kitchen in pale grey, made to order. Rather than the usual factory lacquer it is finished in a pale Farrow & Ball water-based paint. Across the counter, the family can talk while looking at the greenery in the window.
